title.en: Tale 10 — The Ring in the Well

book_meta.author: traditional
book_meta.status: public domain — folk material, no known author

source: retold in modern Hebrew by Claude — NOT native-validated

sentences.en: The ring fell into the well.
The well was deep and dark.
He did not see anything there.
He brought a rope and a bucket from the yard.
He lowered them into the water.
He took out water all morning.
He did not find the ring.
Afterwards he went to the yard.
He brought meat from the kitchen.
He threw it into the well.

sentences.ar: אשתו שאלה: למה עשית את זה?
sentences.en: His wife asked: why did you do that?

sentences.ar: ג'וחא אמר: אני מכיר את הבאר.
sentences.en: Juha said: I know the well.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: היא לא נותנת כלום.
sentences.en: He said: it does not give anything.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: אולי בשביל בשר כן.
sentences.en: He said: maybe for meat it will.
